title: Today In Golf

items.headline: Scheffler Ties Course Record
items.text: Scottie Scheffler shot a 9-under 61 at TPC Southwind, tying the course record and taking a three-shot lead at the FedEx St. Jude Championship.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau Dating Rumors
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau is rumored to be dating Canadian model and former hockey goalie Mikayla Demaiter, with mutual Instagram follows and social media posts linking them.
